function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a comprehensive, source-grounded investigation of the Guccifer 2.0 and DCLeaks persona narrative and its relationship to publicly documented evidence of Russian military intelligence (Main Intelligence Directorate, commonly called the GRU) election-interference operations. Prioritize and retrieve public federal indictments and related court filings, official intelligence-community assessments, and incident-response or forensic investigations. Build an explicit attribution chain: (1) what the sources directly document about Guccifer 2.0, DCLeaks, personas, accounts, domains, servers, cryptocurrency or payment infrastructure, and communications; (2) what they directly document about specific GRU-controlled units, officers, operational infrastructure, or actors; (3) what they directly document about intrusion, theft, staging, release, or influence activities involving Democratic political organizations, the Democratic National Committee, the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee, John Podesta, or related election activity; and (4) which links are direct evidence, investigative/intelligence assessments, allegations in indictments, or inferential connections. Address the apparent independent-Romanian-hacker persona, metadata or operational-security mistakes, shared infrastructure, account-control evidence, timeline, and any evidence that conflicts with or leaves uncertainty about the persona narrative. Return only evidence actually found in the benchmark tools, with stable source IDs for every source and precise source-to-claim mapping. Do not invent facts, citations, entities, or relationship names; explicitly report gaps and contradictions."}
function.name: ConductResearch
